Products.title: Our Premium Collection
Products.description: Lidaco exports the finest Iranian dates and premium pistachios, adhering to international grade standards and custom packaging.

mazafati-bam-dates.name: Mazafati Bam Dates
mazafati-bam-dates.description: Mazafati is one of the most famous dates in the world, renowned for its dark, shiny black appearance and exceptionally soft texture.

piarom-dates.name: Piarom Dates
piarom-dates.description: Piarom (Maryami) dates are semi-dry, dark brown, and possess a uniquely rich, chocolatey flavor with long shelf life.

kabkab-dates.name: Kabkab Dates
kabkab-dates.description: Kabkab dates are highly sweet, fleshy dates with a rich golden-brown color and semi-soft texture.

details.packing: 3kg to 10kg pressed bulk or individual cartons
details.texture: Soft, moist, and high syrup content

rabi-dates.name: Rabi Dates
rabi-dates.description: Rabi dates are elongated, dark brown to black dates that are highly popular in international markets, including China.

details.texture: Chewy, naturally sweet, and long shelf life

akbari-pistachio.name: Akbari Pistachio
akbari-pistachio.description: Akbari is the longest variety of pistachio, recognized as the most luxury and premium grade globally.

details.skin: Creamy white shell with purple kernel
details.texture: Crunchy with rich nut fat content

ahmad-aghaei-pistachio.name: Ahmad Aghaei Pistachio
ahmad-aghaei-pistachio.description: Ahmad Aghaei is a medium-sized, long pistachio featuring a vibrant green kernel and unique aromatic flavor.

details.texture: Extra crispy and deeply savory flavor

fandoghi-pistachio.name: Fandoghi Pistachio
fandoghi-pistachio.description: Fandoghi is a round pistachio and the most common variety exported worldwide due to its excellent quality-price ratio.

details.packing: 50kg bulk gunny bags or custom cartons

kalleh-ghouchi-pistachio.name: Kalleh Ghouchi Pistachio
kalleh-ghouchi-pistachio.description: Kalleh Ghouchi is a jumbo-sized, round pistachio variety with a rich flavor and wide shell opening.

details.texture: Buttery, robust crunch, and extra large size

About.title: About Lidaco
About.tagline: Bridging Premium Iranian Agriculture with Global Markets
About.storyContent: Our journey started in the heart of Bam, where Mazafati dates grow in one of the world's most mineral-rich soils. Lidaco was built to bridge the gap between Iranian farmers and international buyers — without middlemen, without compromise.

sourcing.title: Direct Sourcing
sourcing.description: We establish direct contracts with farms in Bam and Kerman, ensuring full traceability and fair trade practices.

standards.title: Export Standards
standards.description: Our dates and pistachios are sorted, processed, and packed in state-of-the-art facilities meeting international food standards.

partnership.title: Long-Term Partnership
partnership.description: We prioritize consistent supply quality and custom financing agreements to nurture multi-year business relationships.

ownExport.title: Export of Own Products
ownExport.description: Direct export of Lidaco brand Medjool, Mazafati dates, and premium pistachios from our processing facilities.

management.title: Export Management Services
management.description: Serving as export agent for local independent farmers, managing regulatory filings, logistics, and quality assurance.

b2bTrade.title: B2B Trade Networks
b2bTrade.description: Operating dedicated distribution channels and B2B trade partnerships across China, the Middle East, and Europe.

Packaging.title: Export Packaging Standards
Packaging.description: Our state-of-the-art facilities sort, size, process, and pack dates and pistachios under strict hygienic conditions. We offer tailored packaging solutions to meet specific market regulations.
Packaging.retailDesc: Premium boxes ranging from 600g to 1kg, designed with custom artwork for supermarket shelves.
Packaging.vacuumDesc: Designed to maintain moisture (15-25%) and prolong shelf life, preserving the natural color and taste.
Packaging.bulkDesc: Heavy-duty 5kg, 10kg, 25kg, and 50kg cartons or sacks ideal for bulk distributors and food processing customers.

Export.title: Global Export & Logistics
Export.description: Lidaco manages the complete export lifecycle from sourcing at our farms in Bam and Kerman to delivering premium agricultural goods to international ports.
Export.step1Desc: Direct contracts with farmers ensuring traceability, freshness, and quality assurance at origin.
Export.step2Desc: Hygienic sorting, sizing, and packaging inside modern warehouses meeting international food safety standards.
Export.step3Desc: Handling all health inspections, phytosanitary certifications, custom declarations, and prompt shipping from Bandar Abbas port.
